bodyHtml:
Aquasky Successful Aquatech Amsterdam 2019 

Aquatech Amsterdam is a water trade show for process, drinking and waste water. Since 1964, it has been the platform for professionals to exchange know-how, build long-lasting relations and create high-quality leads. About 21,000 visitors from 139 countries and over 850 exhibitors will attend the exhibition. The show is held every two years. It provides a global presence from which you can benefit all year round.
